summary: Dispatcher over a selector a1 (0..33). Each case initializes one row of a large block-structured, double-precision physics dynamics matrix to an identity row: the diagonal element of the row is set to 1.0 and every other stored element of that row is set to 0.0. Longer rows first zero their contiguous element storage via sub_58BB10(dst, 0, byteCount); shorter rows write the zeros directly. The function returns its own selector argument in every path.
